title: Discovery of Dual FGFR4 and EGFR Inhibitors by Machine Learning and Biological Evaluation.
summary: Four machine-learning methods were compared; the selected SVM models screened in-house compounds for dual FGFR4/EGFR inhibition. The primary abstract reports compound 1 kinase IC50 values of 86.2 and 83.9 nM, respectively. This assay result does not establish clinical efficacy.
organization: China Pharmaceutical University; State Key Laboratory of Natural Medicine

evidence.tested: The primary abstract reports four QSAR methods and a selected dual inhibitor with IC50 86.2 nM for FGFR4 and 83.9 nM for EGFR. Assay denominator, comparator, and cell-level validation details were not present in the reviewed abstract; full ACS text was inaccessible.
evidence.unknown: Full Methods and biological-evaluation details were not reviewed. The date is unresolved: ACS header September 14 versus publication-history September 24 and PubMed Epub September 23, 2020.
evidence.ai_role: SVM, random forest, gradient-boost regression tree and XGBoost models were compared after mutual-information feature selection; the best-performing SVM models predicted activity of in-house compounds.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary ACS/PubMed abstract and conflicting publication metadata; complete Methods/Results not reviewed.
